Avocado Night Cream Review: What Real Buyers Say (Pros and Cons)

By Mohammed Nihal, founderPublished 16 October 2026Updated 16 October 20266 min read
Quick answer

Verified buyers on Amazon.in mostly say this avocado night cream feels lightweight, absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft and hydrated by morning, while one found the smell too strong. It contains kojic acid, so wear sunscreen daily; a more even-looking tone takes 8–12 weeks.

  • Key ingredients: avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and kojic acid.
  • The same formula is sold on Amazon.in under sister label Magical Touch.
  • Skin often feels softer in a few nights; a more even-looking tone takes 8–12 weeks with sunscreen.
  • Oily skin should use a thin layer, and the scent can feel strong to some.

Here is our honest avocado night cream review: real buyers mostly say it feels lightweight, absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft and hydrated by morning, while one buyer found the smell too strong. It suits most skin types as a night moisturiser, but it contains kojic acid, so you need sunscreen every morning and patience for a more even-looking tone.

Below we share the texture, smell and feel in Indian weather, who it suits, a realistic timeline, a pros and cons table, and real buyer reviews quoted word for word.

The same formula is also sold on Amazon.in under our sister label, Magical Touch, as Avocado Korean Night Cream (30 g). That is where the buyer reviews below come from.

  • Avocado gives a soft, cushioned feel.
  • Aloe vera keeps it light and fresh.
  • Vitamin B3 supports a smoother-looking surface.
  • Kojic acid is used in cosmetics for a brighter, more even-looking tone. It is typically used at around 1 to 2% in creams.

What real buyers say: verified Amazon.in reviews

These are verified buyer reviews from the Amazon.in listing of our sister label, Magical Touch (Avocado Korean Night Cream, 30 g), quoted exactly as written. We have not edited them or picked only the good ones.

"I've been using Avocado Korean Night Cream regularly, and my skin feels deeply nourished, soft, and hydrated. My dullness has reduced, and my face looks healthier."

"Really impressed with this avocado night cream. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin soft, smooth, and well-hydrated by morning. Great for daily use!"

We include the 3-star review because it matters. Scent is personal, and if you are sensitive to fragrance, it is worth knowing before you buy.

Texture, absorption and smell

Texture. It is a creamy night cream, but the buyers above describe it as lightweight rather than heavy. A pea-sized amount covers the face.

Absorption. Two buyers mention that it absorbs quickly. Press it in gently and give it a few minutes before your face touches the pillow.

Smell. The cream has a noticeable scent. Some people do not mind it, but one buyer found it very strong. If you are unsure, patch test first and see how you feel about the smell over a few nights.

How it feels in Indian weather

  • Summer and humidity. Use a thin layer. More cream will not work faster and can feel heavy in the heat.
  • Monsoon. A thin layer is still enough. Cleanse well before applying, since sweat and pollution build up during the day.
  • Winter. Use a full pea-sized amount, and add a little on the neck.
  • AC rooms. Cooled air dries skin overnight, so keep using it all year if you sleep with the AC on.

Who it suits, and who should be careful

It suits most adults, women and men, who want a simple night moisturiser and a more even-looking tone over time. Dry and normal skin usually enjoy it most. Oily skin can use it too, in a thin layer focused on the cheeks.

Be careful if you have very sensitive skin, a fragrance sensitivity, or skin that reacts to active ingredients. Start every second night for two weeks. Read avocado night cream side effects to know what to watch for, and see a dermatologist first if you are pregnant or have melasma, rashes or painful acne.

Realistic results timeline

  1. First few nights. Skin usually feels softer and less tight in the morning.
  2. First 2 weeks. Dry patches tend to settle and skin looks more hydrated.
  3. 8 to 12 weeks. With nightly use and sunscreen every morning, tone can look more even. Skin renews roughly every 4 to 6 weeks, so this takes time.

It does not change your natural skin colour. It helps skin look healthier and more even with steady use.

Short answers

Is avocado night cream good according to reviews? The verified Amazon.in reviews we quote mostly say it is lightweight, absorbs quickly and leaves skin soft and hydrated. One buyer found the smell too strong.

Does avocado night cream have a strong smell? It has a noticeable scent, and one buyer said it was very strong. Patch test first if you are sensitive to fragrance.

Is it good for oily skin in summer? Yes, in a thin layer at night. Focus on the cheeks and use less on the forehead and nose.

How long before I see results? Softness can show in the first few nights. A more even-looking tone usually takes 8 to 12 weeks with daily sunscreen.

Is the Magical Touch cream the same as Mirc Glow? Yes. Magical Touch is our sister label on Amazon.in, and its Avocado Korean Night Cream uses the same formula.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
